engine_settings.action_tools_desc: Consecutive-call threshold for write tools such as edit, write and exec
engine_settings.context_auto_note: Context compression and retention are computed by the engine from the current model's context window — no manual tuning needed. In long conversations the AI compresses history automatically while keeping what matters.
engine_settings.context_budget_desc: Custom system-level instructions injected into every AI conversation
engine_settings.cycle_detect_desc: Warn or terminate when the AI repeatedly calls the same kind of tool beyond the threshold
engine_settings.deny_paths_desc: The AI never reads or modifies these files and directories (e.g. .env, key files, credential directories)
engine_settings.desktop_desc: Screenshots, keyboard and mouse control and other Computer Use capabilities via the wesgine Desktop adapter
engine_settings.desktop_dev_hint:
This feature needs the wesgine Desktop adapter binary, which is not bundled in this version.
Browser automation (Playwright MCP) is available — configure it under Connections → Browser automation.
engine_settings.exploration_tools_desc: Consecutive-call threshold for read-only tools such as read, grep and ls
engine_settings.govern_mode_locked_desc: Writing files, running commands and similar actions are always denied; only read-only capabilities remain. For demos and managed environments.
engine_settings.govern_mode_open_desc: Writing files, running commands and similar actions go through and are recorded in the audit log. The default for coding.
engine_settings.governance_desc: What the AI may do and what it must not touch
engine_settings.hardline_note: Catastrophic command blocking: 18 commands including rm -rf /, fork bombs and shutdown are permanently blocked
engine_settings.identical_call_desc: Threshold for consecutive tool calls with identical arguments
engine_settings.llm_retry_desc: How many times a failed LLM call is retried automatically
engine_settings.max_entries_session_hint: Runtime memory for the current conversation
engine_settings.memory_gc_note: Above the limit the engine evicts entries that have not been recalled for a long time
engine_settings.memory_policy_desc: Controls whether the AI remembers your preferences and habits automatically
engine_settings.memory_safety_desc: These safeguards are always on and cannot be disabled:
engine_settings.network_allow_desc: No network restriction. Recommended for coding.
engine_settings.network_deny_desc: Blocks every outbound request, including localhost.
engine_settings.network_internal_only_desc: Only localhost and private addresses are reachable.
engine_settings.network_policy_desc: Restricts the AI's outbound access. Tightening this also rejects curl, wget, ssh, scp and rsync in the terminal, which affects dependency installs and similar tasks.
engine_settings.plugins_desc: Extend what the AI assistant can do
engine_settings.plugins_use_mcp: Plugin capabilities are now part of MCP tools
engine_settings.plugins_use_mcp_hint:
Manage external tools and service integrations under Connections → MCP tools.
MCP supports stdio, HTTP and SSE transports, so any compatible tool server can be connected.
engine_settings.redactor_desc: Checked types are masked in AI output, tool results and approval dialogs. All off by default: e-mail addresses and phone numbers in source code are usually test fixtures, and masking them means the AI reads a mask — then writes that mask back into your file.
engine_settings.redactor_floor: API keys and tokens are always masked. That is not configurable here and cannot be turned off.
engine_settings.resilience_desc: Retry strategy and health-detection parameters for failed LLM calls
engine_settings.run_limits_desc: Run parameters, tool execution limits and resource quotas. Rarely need changing — the defaults are tuned for coding.
engine_settings.safety_invisible_strip: Invisible-character stripping (rejected on write, cleaned on read)
engine_settings.safety_quality_gate: Engine state prefixes blocked (plan, task and sub-agent machine state never enters memory)
engine_settings.safety_threat_scan: Credential scanning (API keys, connection strings and tokens are rejected on write)
engine_settings.saved_restart_required: Saved. The following settings take effect after reopening the workspace:
engine_settings.system_prompt_desc: Custom system-level instructions injected into the context of every AI conversation
engine_settings.system_prompt_placeholder: Custom system instructions (leave empty for the default)
engine_settings.termination_note: The engine never terminates a healthy task because of turn or token counts. The CycleDetector is the only in-engine source of termination — it detects provable loops, not "running too long".
engine_settings.thinking_hide_desc: Thinking content never reaches the UI; only the final answer is shown.
engine_settings.thinking_redact_desc: Applies the redaction rules above before showing the thinking.
engine_settings.tool_overrides_desc: Configure warn and terminate thresholds for specific tools
engine_settings.workdir_note: Workspace write boundary: the AI can only modify files inside the current project directory
engine_settings.workspace_required: Open a project folder to configure engine settings
engine_settings.write_policy_gated_desc: Rejects every memory write, so this workspace accumulates nothing. Not a review queue — there is no approval step behind it.
engine_settings.write_policy_logged_desc: Writes go through as usual, and each successful one leaves an audit record.
engine_settings.write_policy_silent_desc: The AI records your preferences without prompting or leaving an audit trail. The default.
